name: evy
description: EVY monorepo - api, web, ios, services and shared types

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names 'postgres,marketplace,api,web' 'docker compose up postgres' 'bun run --cwd services/marketplace dev' 'bun run --cwd api dev' 'bun run --cwd web dev'
scripts.format: bun run --cwd api format && bun run --cwd web format && bun run --cwd services/marketplace format && bunx biome format --write scripts && xcrun swift-format format --in-place --recursive ios
scripts.install:all: bun install && bun install --cwd api && bun install --cwd web && bun install --cwd services/marketplace
scripts.types:generate: bun scripts/generate-types.ts && bun scripts/generate-drizzle.ts && bun scripts/generate-core-resources.ts && bun scripts/generate-marketplace-resources.ts && bunx biome format --write types/generated/ts/
scripts.types:generate:exclude-ios: bun scripts/generate-types.ts --exclude-ios && bun scripts/generate-drizzle.ts && bun scripts/generate-core-resources.ts --exclude-ios && bun scripts/generate-marketplace-resources.ts --exclude-ios && bunx biome format --write types/generated/ts/
